2024-12-01.name: Watashi no Shiawase na Kekkon (2025)
2024-12-01.desc:
* Based on a fantasy romantic light novel series written by Agitogi Akumi and illustrated by Tsukioka Tsukiho.

After months of staying by Kiyoka's side, Miyo is finally invited to the Kudou family villa to meet her future in-laws. Far from receiving a warm welcome, however, she quickly discovers that her fiancé's mother, Fuyu, has no intention of accepting her as his bride. But Miyo will do anything to make her engagement work, even if that means putting up with abuse from Fuyu while attempting to bridge the gap between them. Meanwhile, Kiyoka heads to a nearby village to investigate reports of a fiend that stalks the night...

Source: Yen Press

Note: The first three episodes received an early screening at a special event on 1 December 2024 at Shinjuku Piccadilly in Tokyo which was additionally streamed on Kadokawa's YouTube channel. The regular TV broadcast started on 6 January 2025.

2024-12-05.name: Wu Lian Dianfeng
2024-12-05.desc:
Yang Kai, a trial disciple and floor sweeper at Zhongdu Lingxiao Pavilion, was demoted to a trial disciple due to his poor qualifications. If he did not achieve anything within three years, he would be expelled from the sect. Yang Kai accidentally obtained a mysterious stone pillow, which opened up mysterious skills such as the Proud Golden Body. After that, he continued to practice, breaking through his own limits with his tenacious character as a young man, and finally stood at the top of the inheritance cave. Yang Kai and Su Yan inherited the mysterious skills together, and continued to start his story of becoming a legend and reaching the peak of martial arts.

source: MAL

2024-12-21.name: Duel Masters Lost: Gekka no Shinigami
Quanqiu Gao Wu
2024-12-21.desc:
The 28-year-old Fang Ping was accidentally reborn in a parallel world in 2008, returning to his 18-year-old high school self. This is a world composed of a warrior system, where warriors have extremely high social status and rights. Due to the coincidence of fate with Emperor Zhan Tian in his previous life, a martial arts system was generated in Fang Ping's body after his rebirth. He can convert rare props of any value into martial arts value by touching them, and improve a series of abilities such as bones, tendons, flesh, blood, and mental strength at a speed beyond ordinary people. Through the system's golden finger and his own mind, Fang Ping successfully entered Modu Wuke University for further studies, and in the years to come, he continued to complete his self-growth. Faced with unknown difficulties, he gradually realized the responsibilities that warriors need to bear and the mission of protecting family, friendship, and love.

source: MAL

2024-12-27.name: Shiguang Dailiren: Yingdu Pian
2024-12-27.desc:
To save the deceased Cheng Xiaoshi, Lu Guang returns to the beginning, retracing the path of destiny. However, a photo containing clues about Cheng Xiaoshi's parents appears in the "Time Photo Studio." To uncover the truth, Lu Guang nervously travels to Bridon with Cheng Xiaoshi. Friendly top model Xia Fei, the eccentric leader of Chinatown, Vein, and the mysteriously appearing Liu Xiao... Faced with people harboring different motives, can Lu Guang break the fated deadlock?

2024-12-28.name: S Rank Monster no "Behemoth" Dakedo, Neko to Machigawarete Elf Musume no Pet to Shite Kurashitemasu
2024-12-28.desc:
After dying in battle against the forces of evil, a knight is reborn as a behemoth—one of the most powerful monsters in the world! However, baby behemoths look an awful lot like adorable house cats. Just when he thinks his situation couldn't be more confusing, a beautiful elven adventurer rescues him from the brink of death and adopts him as her pet. This "cat's" baffling journey is just getting started.

Source: HIDIVE

Note: The first episode premiered on 7 December 2024 at Anime Frontier in Fort Worth, Texas. The regular broadcast started on 28 December 2024.
